methodology_other:
Dataset: received from government Centre National de l'Information Géo-Spatiale (C.N.I.G.S) with pcodes created from government IDs. Spatial Data is from 2013

These shapefiles incorporate improvements developed in 2017.  Apart from certain corrections, the P-code system is redesigned to be a constant character width.

Administrative levels 2, 1, and 0 are geometrically dissolved from administrative level 3.
name: cod-ab-hti
notes:
Haiti administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 10 Departement  
- Admin 2: 140 Commune  
- Admin 3: 570 section communale / Communal Section  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 06 January 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 29 November 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 29 March 1987: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 29 March 1987: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Haiti](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-haiti).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
